ILLUMINUS.Settings.Manager.Name: Journal Styles
ILLUMINUS.Settings.Manager.Label: Open Style Library
ILLUMINUS.Settings.Manager.Hint: Create and edit the decorative looks you can apply to individual journals.
ILLUMINUS.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug Logging
ILLUMINUS.Settings.Debug.Hint: Print verbose Illuminus messages to the browser console. Affects only your client.
ILLUMINUS.Manager.Title: Journal Style Library
ILLUMINUS.Manager.Hint: A style is a saved look. Apply one to any journal from that journal's window header, or by right-clicking it in the sidebar.
ILLUMINUS.Manager.Empty: No styles yet. Create one, or import a style file someone shared with you.
ILLUMINUS.Manager.PresetTooltip: Came with Illuminus. Edit or delete it freely.
ILLUMINUS.Manager.Unused: Not used by any journal yet
ILLUMINUS.Editor.Title: Edit Style
ILLUMINUS.Picker.Title: Journal Style
ILLUMINUS.Picker.Label: Style
ILLUMINUS.Picker.Hint: Choose the look to use for "{name}". Only this journal is affected.
ILLUMINUS.Picker.NoStyles: There are no styles in this world yet. Would you like to open the style library and make one?
ILLUMINUS.Buttons.ResetGroupTooltip: Return every setting on this tab to its starting value
ILLUMINUS.Buttons.ResetAllTooltip: Return every setting on every tab to its starting value
ILLUMINUS.Groups.page.label: The Page
ILLUMINUS.Groups.page.hint: The paper the text sits on: its colour, any background texture, and the frame around it.
ILLUMINUS.Groups.title.label: Journal Title
ILLUMINUS.Groups.title.hint: The journal's name, shown across the top of the window.
ILLUMINUS.Groups.heading1.label: Major Headings
ILLUMINUS.Groups.heading1.hint: The largest headings — page titles and chapter openers.
ILLUMINUS.Groups.heading2.label: Section Headings
ILLUMINUS.Groups.heading2.hint: Mid-level headings that break a page into sections.
ILLUMINUS.Groups.heading3.label: Minor Headings
ILLUMINUS.Groups.heading3.hint: The smallest headings. Also used for anything smaller still.
ILLUMINUS.Groups.body.label: Body Text
ILLUMINUS.Groups.body.hint: Ordinary paragraphs — the bulk of what people read.
ILLUMINUS.Groups.links.label: Links
ILLUMINUS.Groups.links.hint: Clickable references to other documents, rolls, and web pages.
ILLUMINUS.Groups.lists.label: Lists
ILLUMINUS.Groups.tables.label: Tables
ILLUMINUS.Groups.tables.hint: Tables of results, treasure, encounters, and the like.
ILLUMINUS.Groups.boxes.label: Boxed Text
ILLUMINUS.Groups.boxes.hint: Set-apart passages, such as read-aloud description. Applies to quote blocks in the editor.
ILLUMINUS.Groups.images.label: Pictures
ILLUMINUS.Groups.images.hint: Images placed in a page, and their captions.
ILLUMINUS.Field.background.label: Background Colour
ILLUMINUS.Field.background.hint: The flat colour behind everything else.
ILLUMINUS.Field.texture.label: Background Picture
ILLUMINUS.Field.texture.hint: An image laid over the background colour, such as a parchment scan. Leave empty for none.
ILLUMINUS.Field.textureFit.label: Picture Fit
ILLUMINUS.Field.textureFit.hint: How the background picture covers the page.
ILLUMINUS.Field.textureBlend.label: Picture Blending
ILLUMINUS.Field.textureBlend.hint: How the picture mixes with the background colour. "Multiply" keeps paper texture while letting the colour show through.
ILLUMINUS.Field.padding.label: Inner Margin
ILLUMINUS.Field.padding.hint: Empty space between the edge of the page and its contents.
ILLUMINUS.Field.maxWidth.label: Maximum Text Width
ILLUMINUS.Field.maxWidth.hint: Stops lines growing too long to read comfortably. Set to 0 for no limit.
ILLUMINUS.Field.borderColor.label: Border Colour
ILLUMINUS.Field.borderColor.hint: Colour of the line around the edge.
ILLUMINUS.Field.borderStyle.label: Border Style
ILLUMINUS.Field.borderStyle.hint: What the surrounding line looks like, or none at all.
ILLUMINUS.Field.borderWidth.label: Border Thickness
ILLUMINUS.Field.borderWidth.hint: How heavy the surrounding line is.
ILLUMINUS.Field.radius.label: Corner Rounding
ILLUMINUS.Field.radius.hint: How rounded the corners are. 0 is a sharp corner.
ILLUMINUS.Field.innerShadow.label: Aged Edges
ILLUMINUS.Field.innerShadow.hint: Darkens the inside edges, as though the page has aged or been lit from the centre.
ILLUMINUS.Field.font.label: Typeface
ILLUMINUS.Field.font.hint: Which lettering to use. Add more under Foundry's Configure Font Families menu.
ILLUMINUS.Field.size.label: Text Size
ILLUMINUS.Field.color.label: Text Colour
ILLUMINUS.Field.align.label: Alignment
ILLUMINUS.Field.align.hint: Which edge the text lines up against.
ILLUMINUS.Field.weight.label: Thickness
ILLUMINUS.Field.style.label: Slant
ILLUMINUS.Field.caps.label: Capitals
ILLUMINUS.Field.caps.hint: Force capital letters, or use small capitals for a printed-book feel.
ILLUMINUS.Field.letterSpacing.label: Letter Spacing
ILLUMINUS.Field.letterSpacing.hint: Extra space between letters. A little goes a long way on headings.
ILLUMINUS.Field.shadow.label: Drop Shadow
ILLUMINUS.Field.shadow.hint: A soft shadow behind the text to lift it off the page.
ILLUMINUS.Field.spaceAbove.label: Space Above
ILLUMINUS.Field.spaceAbove.hint: Gap between this heading and whatever comes before it.
ILLUMINUS.Field.spaceBelow.label: Space Below
ILLUMINUS.Field.spaceBelow.hint: Gap between this heading and the text under it.
ILLUMINUS.Field.paddingX.label: Side Padding
ILLUMINUS.Field.paddingX.hint: Space inside the heading's banner, left and right. Only visible when a background colour is set.
ILLUMINUS.Field.paddingY.label: Top and Bottom Padding
ILLUMINUS.Field.paddingY.hint: Space inside the heading's banner, above and below. Only visible when a background colour is set.
ILLUMINUS.Field.ruleStyle.label: Underline Style
ILLUMINUS.Field.ruleStyle.hint: A ruled line beneath the heading, running the full width.
ILLUMINUS.Field.ruleColor.label: Underline Colour
ILLUMINUS.Field.ruleWidth.label: Underline Thickness
ILLUMINUS.Field.ruleWidth.hint: How heavy the ruled line is.
ILLUMINUS.Field.lineHeight.label: Line Spacing
ILLUMINUS.Field.lineHeight.hint: Space between lines within a paragraph. 1.5 is comfortable for long reading.
ILLUMINUS.Field.paragraphSpacing.label: Paragraph Spacing
ILLUMINUS.Field.paragraphSpacing.hint: Gap between one paragraph and the next.
ILLUMINUS.Field.firstLineIndent.label: First Line Indent
ILLUMINUS.Field.firstLineIndent.hint: Pushes the first line of each paragraph inward, as in a printed novel.
ILLUMINUS.Field.dropCap.label: Opening Capital
ILLUMINUS.Field.dropCap.hint: Enlarges the first letter of the page so it spans several lines.
ILLUMINUS.Field.dropCapColor.label: Opening Capital Colour
ILLUMINUS.Field.dropCapColor.hint: Colour of that enlarged first letter.
ILLUMINUS.Field.hoverColor.label: Colour When Pointed At
ILLUMINUS.Field.hoverColor.hint: Colour a link turns when the mouse is over it.
ILLUMINUS.Field.underline.label: Underlined
ILLUMINUS.Field.chipBackground.label: Highlight Colour
ILLUMINUS.Field.chipBackground.hint: A block of colour behind links, making them look like buttons. Use a fully transparent colour for none.
ILLUMINUS.Field.chipBorderColor.label: Outline Colour
ILLUMINUS.Field.chipBorderColor.hint: A thin outline around links. Use a fully transparent colour for none.
ILLUMINUS.Field.chipRadius.label: Highlight Rounding
ILLUMINUS.Field.chipRadius.hint: How rounded the highlight behind a link is.
ILLUMINUS.Field.bullet.label: Bullet Shape
ILLUMINUS.Field.bullet.hint: The mark in front of each item in a bulleted list.
ILLUMINUS.Field.markerColor.label: Bullet Colour
ILLUMINUS.Field.markerColor.hint: Colour of bullets and item numbers.
ILLUMINUS.Field.indent.label: Indent
ILLUMINUS.Field.indent.hint: How far a list is pushed in from the left.
ILLUMINUS.Field.itemSpacing.label: Spacing Between Items
ILLUMINUS.Field.itemSpacing.hint: Gap between one list item and the next.
ILLUMINUS.Field.headerBackground.label: Header Row Colour
ILLUMINUS.Field.headerBackground.hint: Background of the top row of a table.
ILLUMINUS.Field.headerColor.label: Header Text Colour
ILLUMINUS.Field.headerColor.hint: Lettering colour in the top row of a table.
ILLUMINUS.Field.headerFont.label: Header Typeface
ILLUMINUS.Field.headerFont.hint: Lettering used in the top row of a table.
ILLUMINUS.Field.textColor.label: Text Colour
ILLUMINUS.Field.stripeColor.label: Alternating Row Colour
ILLUMINUS.Field.stripeColor.hint: Shading on every other row, to help the eye track across. Use a mostly transparent colour.
ILLUMINUS.Field.cellPaddingX.label: Cell Side Padding
ILLUMINUS.Field.cellPaddingX.hint: Space inside each cell, left and right.
ILLUMINUS.Field.cellPaddingY.label: Cell Top and Bottom Padding
ILLUMINUS.Field.cellPaddingY.hint: Space inside each cell, above and below.
ILLUMINUS.Field.edge.label: Which Edges Are Marked
ILLUMINUS.Field.edge.hint: Where the accent line sits. A single left edge is the usual look for read-aloud text.
ILLUMINUS.Field.spacing.label: Space Around the Box
ILLUMINUS.Field.spacing.hint: Gap between the box and the text above and below it.
ILLUMINUS.Field.captionColor.label: Caption Colour
ILLUMINUS.Field.captionColor.hint: Lettering colour of a picture's caption.
ILLUMINUS.Field.captionSize.label: Caption Size
ILLUMINUS.Field.captionStyle.label: Caption Slant
ILLUMINUS.Field.captionAlign.label: Caption Alignment
ILLUMINUS.Field.captionAlign.hint: Which edge a caption lines up against.
ILLUMINUS.Confirm.Delete: Delete the style "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
ILLUMINUS.Confirm.DeleteInUse: {count} journal(s) currently use this style. They will go back to Foundry's default appearance.
ILLUMINUS.Confirm.ResetGroup: Return every setting on the "{group}" tab to its starting value?
ILLUMINUS.Confirm.ResetAll: Return every setting on every tab to its starting value? Your unsaved work on this style will be lost.
ILLUMINUS.Confirm.Revert: Discard your unsaved changes and go back to the last saved version of this style?
ILLUMINUS.Preview.Body1: Black water laps at the foot of the altar steps, and something below the surface has been waiting a very long time. See also
ILLUMINUS.Preview.Boxed: The doors give way with a groan of swollen timber. Beyond, cold air rises off still water, and your torchlight finds nothing to catch on.
ILLUMINUS.Preview.Item1: A tarnished silver censer, still faintly warm
ILLUMINUS.Preview.Item2: Three prayer books, their pages fused solid
ILLUMINUS.Preview.Caption: The chapel as it stood before the flood.
ILLUMINUS.Notifications.NothingToExport: No styles were selected to export.
ILLUMINUS.Errors.ImportShape: That file is not an Illuminus style file. It should contain a list of styles.
ILLUMINUS.Errors.ImportParse: That file could not be read as JSON: {message}
ILLUMINUS.Errors.ImportNoStyles: That file contained no styles Illuminus could recognise.
ILLUMINUS.Errors.ImportForeign: This file was exported by "{module}", not Illuminus. Importing anyway.
ILLUMINUS.Errors.ImportNewer: This file was made with a newer version of Illuminus (format {found}, this version reads {supported}). Anything unrecognised was skipped.
ILLUMINUS.Errors.ImportEmptyStyle: Skipped "{name}" — it had no settings Illuminus recognised.
